_note: FoJin connector (2026-10-20 extension pack 44). Buddhist canon tools: search, passages, cross-canon parallels, dictionaries — all URN-cited. Free, no key required (anon rate-limited). Home: https://fojin.app · MCP: https://mcp.fojin.ai/mcp · PyPI: fojin-mcp. Interoperable URN scheme maps to CBETA / SuttaCentral (sc/) / 84000 / GRETIL numbering.

access.api_base_note: The MCP server calls the FoJin API internally; we use the MCP endpoint directly.
access.install: claude mcp add --transport http fojin https://mcp.fojin.ai/mcp  OR  uvx fojin-mcp

tools.name: search_corpus
tools.use: semantic search across aggregated canon — every hit carries a fojin: URN

tools.name: get_parallels
tools.use: cross-canon aligned parallels (Chinese↔Pali↔Tibetan) — the comparative engine for topic hubs

tools.name: lookup_entity
tools.use: knowledge-graph entities — people, places, works, terms

tools.name: resolve_urn
tools.use: resolve a fojin: URN to reader URL + existence

tools.name: verify_quote
tools.use: verbatim check — does this quote exist in the canon? honest cite_matched/juan_matched or near-miss. CALL THIS before serving any quoted scripture.

tools.name: commentaries
tools.use: for one passage, what historical commentators wrote — anchored to juan and line

licence: Apache-2.0 (code) / data: per-source (SuttaCentral CC0, CBETA CC BY-NC-SA, 84000 per terms) — link, never rehost

satsang_use.topic_hubs: get_parallels on the key topic for cross-tradition compare sections
satsang_use.chat_enquiry: verify_quote before any quoted scripture appears in chat output
satsang_use.practice_sources: search_corpus to find the right sutta id for a practice's source row
satsang_use.translations: lookup_dictionary for archaic Pali/Sanskrit terms in practice step text
satsang_use.fojin_check_in_targets: each targets entry carries a fojin_check field naming which tool to call for that text
